texts.preamble: Rahul Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 December, 2024 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:194168 Court No. - 79 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 36876 of 2024 Applicant :- Rahul Gupta Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Srijan Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
texts.arguments: Contention of the learned counsel for the applicant is that the Food Analyst report was received on 10.11.2006, but complaint was filed in October, 2008, therefore, complaint is barred by latches. 4. The second submission of learned counsel for the applicant is that after taking the sample, the same should have been produced before the Magistrate under Section 11 (4) of the Food and Rahul Gupta vs State Of U.P. And Another on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/192971294/ 1 Adulteration Act but the same was not produced before the Magistrate, therefore, entire prosecution is bad in law. 5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. submits that the impugned complaint was filed in the year 2008 and the applicant has also appeared before the Court and the matter was posted for proceeding under Section 244 Cr.P.C., thereafter, the matter kept on adjourning and finally after almost 16 years, the applicant cannot approach this Court to quash the impugned proceeding on the ground raised by the applicant. Therefore, there is no illegality in the impugned proceeding. 6. Considering the rival submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the record, it appears that the impugned complaint was filed in the year 2008 after taking permission from the required authority, therefore, at this stage it cannot be said that the complaint was time barred.
